linesEn: Sophia, are you sure Jonah went this way?

linesZhTw: 冰海的冰原到黑森林去，
走這段行程的話，我想這條
linesZhCn: 冰海的冰原到黑森林去，
走这段行程的话，我想这条
linesEn: He said he was heading due north across the frozen sea towards the Black Forest.
If that is his route, then I believe this path...
...should be the right one.
I don't know why, but something feels off here...
Could we have taken a wrong turn?

linesZhTw: 是頗為陌生。早知道不該抄
linesZhCn: 是颇为陌生。早知道不该抄
linesEn: Mm... the surroundings do look quite unfamiliar.
If only we hadn't tried to take a shortcut...
Look out! Someone's nearby!
Grahh! I spot humans up ahead!
What do we do?
Grr... We're supposed to be the only ones who know about the treasure here!
Grahh... Who cares!
Anyone in our way dies!
Yeah! Slaughter them all!

linesZhTw: 又不講理，我們準備應戰吧
linesZhCn: 又不讲理，我们准备应战吧
linesEn: Trouble. These orcs are as thick-headed as they are savage.
Brace yourselves for battle!
Still, what treasure were they talking about?

linesZhTw: 夫森林不遠，可是這裡的景
linesZhCn: 夫森林不远，可是这里的景
linesEn: I have no idea. We shouldn't be far from the Elf Forest,
yet I've never seen these woods before...

linesZhTw: 你怎麼會跑到這裡來了？』
linesZhCn: 你怎么会跑到这里来了？』
linesEn: Huh? Isn't that Beckway?
What on earth are you doing here?

linesZhTw: 珊嘛！好久不見啦，聽說妳
後來跟著大法師穆勒學法術
linesZhCn: 珊嘛！好久不见啦，听说你
后来跟着大法师穆勒学法术
linesEn: You're Shan, my old neighbor!
It's been so long! I heard you went off to study magic under Archmage Muller...

linesZhTw: 去了…對了，妳在這裡幹什
linesZhCn: 去了…对了，你在这里干什
linesEn: ...By the way, what are you doing here?

linesZhTw: 長老的藏寶之處，以前叫做
linesZhCn: 长老的藏宝之处，以前叫做
linesEn: This is the Mist Forest, the ancient sanctuary where our elven elders hid their treasures...

linesZhTw: 向有大霧籠罩，我們從小就
被告誡不準接近……這又怎
linesZhCn: 向有大雾笼罩，我们从小就
被告诫不准接近……这又怎
linesEn: Right, now I remember... Shrouded in dense mist, we were forbidden from coming near as children.
...So what happened?

linesZhTw: 護此地的結界不知怎的失效
了，這些獸人得知此地有寶
linesZhCn: 护此地的结界不知怎的失效
了，这些兽人得知此地有宝
linesEn: With the recent cataclysms, the barrier protecting this place for a millennium broke down.
Once the orcs learned there was treasure here...
...they swooped in to pillage everything!
What?! Unbelievable!

linesZhTw: 帶來的！都給我一起殺了
linesZhCn: 带来的！都给我一起杀了
linesEn: Grahh... So you brought reinforcements!
Kill them all!

linesZhTw: 些寶物吧！至少不要讓它們
linesZhCn: 些宝物吧！至少不要让它们
linesEn: Beckway, help me protect these treasures!
We can't let them fall into the hands of these orcs...!
But we have an urgent journey ahead...

linesZhTw: 動筋骨，也沒什麼不好啊！
linesZhCn: 动筋骨，也没什么不好啊！
linesEn: No harm done! A little exercise beforehand never hurt anybody!
Thanks, Thor! Shan, stay close and be careful!

linesZhTw: 可以了，我知道你會保護我
linesZhCn: 可以了，我知道你会保护我
linesEn: Don't worry, I'll stay right behind you. I know you'll keep me safe!
I can never win an argument with you...
All right, everyone, move out!

linesZhTw: 我代表精靈族謝謝各位。』
linesZhCn: 我代表精灵族谢谢各位。』
linesEn: Thanks to everyone's help, the orcs have finally been driven off...
On behalf of the elves, I thank you all.

linesZhTw: 你難得遇見一個童年舊友，
linesZhCn: 你难得遇见一个童年旧友，
linesEn: Think nothing of it!
By the way, Master Beckway, it's not every day you run into a childhood friend.
Aren't you going to stay a while and catch up with her?

linesZhTw: 雖然這愛爾夫森林是我的家
鄉，我想我沒時間在此停留
linesZhCn: 虽然这爱尔夫森林是我的家
乡，我想我没时间在此停留
linesEn: Jonah's mission is far too urgent. The Elf Forest may be my home, but there's no time to linger...
...not right now.
An urgent mission? Tell me, tell me!
It must be exciting!

linesZhTw: 可不是小孩時代的玩意…』
linesZhCn: 可不是小孩时代的玩意…』
linesEn: Shan! This is deadly serious, not child's play!

linesZhTw: 好，我就和你一起去一趟，
linesZhCn: 好，我就和你一起去一趟，
linesEn: What! You think I'm joking?
Fine then, I'm coming along to see what this big deal is all about!
Don't be reckless! This journey is far too dangerous.
You'd better stay right here...

linesZhTw: 心你嗎？至少我也是大法師
linesZhCn: 心你吗？至少我也是大法师
linesEn: If it's so dangerous, don't you think I'd worry about you?
Besides, I happen to be the prize apprentice of Archmage Muller!

linesZhTw: 家鄉八成也一樣不安分，
linesZhCn: 家乡八成也一样不安分，
linesEn: Sigh... I can never talk you out of anything.
You'd probably get into trouble staying here anyway, so come along!
Wonderful! Thank you!
My name is Shan. I look forward to fighting alongside you all!

linesZhTw: 現在請妳當嚮導帶我們走過
linesZhCn: 现在请你当向导带我们走过
linesEn: Welcome aboard! Now then, would you guide us through this forest?
Leave it to me! Follow me, everyone!
